name: GUARD_DISTRIBUTED_V2 -- unique threat assignment for the multi-defender GUARD probe
authority: PI, 2026-09-05, after the 4v4 Pole-A reversal: 'The clean fix is not to change Pole A until it passes. The likely problem is the scaled GUARD probe itself: multiple defenders are being added, but they are not coordinating coverage ... That does not change the strategic pole to force a pass.'

timing_disclosure.when: written after the 4v4 certification returned NOT_CERTIFIED and after the stacking diagnostic quantified the mechanism, but BEFORE any GUARD_DISTRIBUTED_V2 code exists and before any new certification row.
NOT_visible_when_written: any GUARD_DISTRIBUTED_V2 measurement at any team size
timing_disclosure.why_this_is_not_tuning_to_pass: the repair targets a mechanism MEASURED to be broken (stacked defenders leave k-1 threats unopposed, and multi-threat steps are 3.3x more frequent at 4v4 than 2v2), not the pole that produced the unwanted number. The poles are untouched.

WHAT_IS_BEING_REPAIRED_AND_WHY_IT_IS_THE.the_probe_defect: GUARD_V1 commits ceil(N/2) defenders but assigns them ALL the identical target (_scripted_blue_styles.py: target_x[:, lo:] = def_x.unsqueeze(1)). Defensive capacity therefore does not scale with defender count: with k simultaneous threats, exactly one is contested and k-1 are unopposed no matter how many defenders GUARD commits.
WHAT_IS_BEING_REPAIRED_AND_WHY_IT_IS_THE.measured_consequence: DEFENDER_STACKING_DIAGNOSTIC.json -- multi-threat contested steps are 9.55% at 2v2 but 31.08% at 4v4, and 239 of 285 multi-threat steps at 4v4 have exactly 2 intruders, i.e. fully coverable by the 2 defenders GUARD already commits if they split.
WHAT_IS_BEING_REPAIRED_AND_WHY_IT_IS_THE.why_2v2_was_unaffected: ceil(2/2)=1 defender cannot stack. The V1 rule is degenerate-but-correct at 2v2 and only becomes wrong at N>2, which is why the certified 2v2 result is untouched by this repair.
WHAT_IS_BEING_REPAIRED_AND_WHY_IT_IS_THE.poles_remain_frozen: OP6/OP7 parameters, defender_zone_frac, threat_radius and min_alive_for_defender=N are ALL unchanged. This spec edits only the BLUE probe.

THE_RULE.name: GUARD_DISTRIBUTED_V2
THE_RULE.defender_count: UNCHANGED: ceil(N/2) defenders, occupying the last ceil(N/2) agent indices
assignment: 1. collect the active defenders (the last ceil(N/2) indices)
2. collect the legal threats: enemy agents that are alive, untagged, and on our side -- the SAME predicate the behaviour tree already uses, read from the live core
4. assign defenders to DISTINCT threats greedily by smallest distance, deterministically, breaking ties by (threat index, defender index) so no RNG is drawn
5. only when defenders outnumber available threats may two defenders share a target; surplus defenders fall back to the existing hold-on-flag behaviour
THE_RULE.everything_else_unchanged: each assigned defender then uses the EXISTING per-defender behaviour verbatim -- intercept the assigned threat, refuse to pursue past the midline, clamp into the defensive disc of radius gate2b_defender_hold_radius. No new defensive behaviour is invented; only WHICH threat each defender is given changes.
THE_RULE.determinism: no RNG anywhere; identical seeds must reproduce identical assignments.

MANDATORY_2V2_REGRESSION_GUARD.requirement: GUARD_DISTRIBUTED_V2 must be BIT-IDENTICAL to GUARD_V1 at N=2 before any new certification row is collected.
MANDATORY_2V2_REGRESSION_GUARD.why_it_must_hold: at N=2 there is exactly one defender, so greedy unique assignment reduces to 'the single defender takes the nearest legal threat' -- precisely the V1 rule. Any 2v2 difference would mean the implementation changed more than the assignment and would invalidate the certified 2v2 strategic-demand result and everything downstream of it.
MANDATORY_2V2_REGRESSION_GUARD.check: on a fixed seed set, V1 and V2 must produce identical defender targets at N=2, elementwise.
MANDATORY_2V2_REGRESSION_GUARD.if_it_fails: STOP. Do not proceed to certification.

CERTIFICATION_PROTOCOL_FOR_V2.seeds: FRESH blocks, disjoint from every prior block. The v1 certification blocks (4v4 12400001..064, 6v6 12600001..064) are SPENT and MUST NOT be reused for a v2 certification.
CERTIFICATION_PROTOCOL_FOR_V2.disjointness_required: grepped against every JSON under artifacts/strategic_demand/ immediately before the run, and the check recorded
CERTIFICATION_PROTOCOL_FOR_V2.gate: UNCHANGED: delta_A > 0 AND LCB95(delta_A) > 0 AND delta_B > 0 AND LCB95(delta_B) > 0. Same paired percentile bootstrap, n_boot=20000, alpha=0.05, rng_seed=7, seed as the resampling unit.
CERTIFICATION_PROTOCOL_FOR_V2.v1_results_are_retained: STRATEGIC_DEMAND_4v4_CERTIFICATION.json stays NOT_CERTIFIED and is not deleted, superseded or rewritten. The v2 run is a SEPARATE record.
CERTIFICATION_PROTOCOL_FOR_V2.6v6: the same repair and a fresh v2 certification apply at 6v6 if the same coordination problem appears there; the in-flight 6v6 v1 certification is allowed to finish and is retained whatever it says.

STOPPING_RULE_FROZEN_NOW.verbatim: If GUARD_DISTRIBUTED_V2 still fails certification, do NOT keep modifying GUARD until it passes. At that point reconsider whether the original 2v2 strategic contrast truly scales.
STOPPING_RULE_FROZEN_NOW.why_it_is_frozen_before_the_result: this is the second probe design. A third, fourth and fifth would each have a plausible-sounding rationale, and the cumulative effect would be tuning the environment until the answer turns green. One measured defect, one principled repair, one fresh test.
STOPPING_RULE_FROZEN_NOW.what_a_second_failure_would_license: the honest reading that the 2v2 strategic contrast may not scale to larger teams -- a legitimate negative external-validity result, and one the paper can state, since the nominal 2v2 claims never depended on it.

NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_SPEC: any change to OP6/OP7, defender_zone_frac, threat_radius or min_alive_for_defender
any change to the BREACH probe (BLUE_BOTH_ATTACK_V2 already expands to all N and needs none)
any change to the crossover gate or bootstrap
reuse of the v1 certification seed blocks
specialist training at any size (still gated on a CERTIFIED verdict)
SEQUENCE: freeze this spec -> implement GUARD_DISTRIBUTED_V2 -> prove bit-identical at N=2 -> fresh-seed 4v4 certification -> fresh-seed 6v6 certification if warranted -> report
